description: Pre-approved library registry. Agents pick FROM this list; they do NOT autonomously add new entries. To approve a new library, the user (or orchestrator on user direction) edits this file directly. The vault's role is to maintain the list; per-project installation happens at task-execution time only for libraries the agent decides the task actually needs.

policy.install_scope: per-task — only what the current task requires lands in the project's package.json
policy.version_pinning: ranges set here travel cross-machine via the vault repo; each project's package.json captures the resolved version when first installed for that project
policy.cross_machine_sync: this file is vault-tracked, so cloning the vault gives the new machine the same approved registry. Each user-project (under code/<project>/ or external) carries its own package.json/lock that records what it actually installed.

categories.frontend.styling: CSS frameworks, design-token systems, utility-first styling
categories.frontend.components: Component primitives and pre-built UI kits
categories.frontend.theming: Theme switching, dark/light mode, theme tokens

tailwindcss.purpose: Utility-first CSS framework. Pick when the project has no existing CSS framework, or when a broad restyle is in scope. Works on CRA, Next.js, Vite, plain HTML.
setup_steps: npm install --save-dev tailwindcss@^3 postcss autoprefixer @tailwindcss/typography
Create tailwind.config.js with content paths pointing at src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx} and public/index.html (CRA) or app/** (Next.js).
Create postcss.config.js with tailwindcss + autoprefixer plugins.
Add @tailwind base/components/utilities directives at the top of the CSS entry file (e.g. src/index.css).
darkMode: ['class'] in tailwind config if dark-mode toggling is in scope.

postcss.purpose: Required by Tailwind. Pulled in as a peer of tailwindcss.

autoprefixer.purpose: Required by Tailwind. Pulled in as a peer of tailwindcss.

@tailwindcss/typography.purpose: Typography plugin for Tailwind. Useful for content-heavy pages (marketing, docs).

shadcn.purpose: Copy-paste component library built on Radix primitives + Tailwind. Use for distinctive, accessible UI primitives (Button, Dialog, Dropdown, Input, etc.). Components live in the project under src/components/ui/, not in node_modules — they're code you own and can modify.
setup_steps: Requires Tailwind installed + configured first.
Create jsconfig.json (or tsconfig.json) with baseUrl 'src' and paths { '@/*': ['./*'] }.

Create components.json at project root with the standard shadcn schema (style: 'default', tailwind config path, css path, baseColor: 'neutral' or 'zinc', cssVariables: true, aliases components='@/components', utils='@/lib/utils').
Create src/lib/utils.js with the cn() helper that does twMerge(clsx(...)).
Add Tailwind CSS variables for the theme (e.g. --background, --foreground, --primary, etc.) at the top of src/index.css.
Then 'npx shadcn@latest add <component>' (e.g. button, dialog, dropdown-menu, input) to install individual components.

framer-motion.purpose: Declarative animation library for React. Page transitions, layout animation (auto-animate-on-content-change), gesture support, scroll-driven animation. Pick this when a redesign promises 'motion' or 'moving parts'.
setup_steps: npm install framer-motion
Wrap animated elements in <motion.div>, <motion.button>, etc.
Use initial/animate/exit props for entrance/exit; layout prop for FLIP-style auto-layout; whileHover/whileTap for interactions.
For page transitions, wrap routes in <AnimatePresence>.
incompatible_with: gsap (pick one motion library, don't mix)

three.purpose: WebGL 3D engine. Used as the underlying library; declarative usage via @react-three/fiber.

@react-three/fiber.purpose: React renderer for three.js. Use <Canvas> + JSX-like 3D scene composition. Pick when a redesign wants hero/background 3D, interactive scenes, or particle/shader effects.
setup_steps: npm install three @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei
Wrap 3D content in <Canvas> from @react-three/fiber.
Use @react-three/drei helpers (OrbitControls, Environment, Float, etc.) for common patterns.

@react-three/drei.purpose: Helper components and hooks for @react-three/fiber (cameras, controls, loaders, postprocessing, etc.).

@radix-ui/colors.purpose: Open-source color system designed for product design. 30+ paired scales (gray, mauve, slate, blue, red, etc.) each with 12 steps tuned for backgrounds / text / borders / interaction states / focus rings. Pick this over hand-picked hex values when a redesign wants a coherent palette beyond a single accent.
setup_steps: npm install @radix-ui/colors
Import the scales you need (e.g. import { slate, blueDark } from '@radix-ui/colors';).
Map them onto CSS custom properties or Tailwind theme.extend.colors.

@radix-ui/react-dialog.purpose: Accessible modal dialog primitive. Use directly OR via shadcn's <Dialog> wrapper.

@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu.purpose: Accessible dropdown menu primitive (keyboard nav, focus management). Use directly OR via shadcn's <DropdownMenu>.

@radix-ui/react-checkbox.purpose: Accessible checkbox primitive. Use directly OR via shadcn's <Checkbox>.

@radix-ui/react-label.purpose: Accessible <label> primitive that links to form controls.

@radix-ui/react-slot.purpose: Helper for shadcn-style component composition (asChild prop pattern). Pulled in implicitly when adding most shadcn components.

@radix-ui/react-tooltip.purpose: Accessible tooltip primitive. Use directly OR via shadcn's <Tooltip>.

next-themes.purpose: Theme provider for React (works on CRA + Next.js + Vite). Handles dark/light toggle, persistence, system preference, and forced theme overrides. Pick when a redesign needs theme switching or system-aware dark mode. Skip when the design is single-theme.
setup_steps: npm install next-themes
Wrap the app in <ThemeProvider attribute='class' defaultTheme='dark' enableSystem>.
Use useTheme() hook to read/write the current theme.

lucide-react.purpose: Open-source icon set (1000+ icons, tree-shakeable React components). Already a dep on the warcraftlogs-tracker project; treat as default icon set across vault-managed frontends.
setup_steps: npm install lucide-react
Import individual icons: import { Play, FolderOpen } from 'lucide-react';

clsx.purpose: Tiny utility for conditional class-name composition. Pairs with tailwind-merge in the cn() helper.

tailwind-merge.purpose: Merges Tailwind class-name conflicts intelligently (e.g. 'px-2 px-4' becomes 'px-4'). Required by shadcn's cn() helper.

class-variance-authority.purpose: Variant prop pattern for component APIs (Button variant='solid' size='lg'). Used by shadcn components.

react-hook-form.purpose: Form state management with validation. Pick when a redesign touches form-heavy pages (auth, settings, multi-step flows). Skip for simple two-field forms.

recharts.purpose: Declarative React charting library. Composable primitives (LineChart, BarChart, AreaChart, PieChart, Tooltip, Legend, etc.). Built-in animation, responsive containers, customizable via Tailwind/CSS. Pick this for damage breakdowns, time-series, comparisons, distributions in data tools and dashboards.
setup_steps: npm install recharts
Wrap charts in <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={H}> for layout.
Color series via the stroke/fill props; pull values from your design tokens for consistency.
Use the animationDuration prop to tune motion; disable with isAnimationActive={false} when chart updates are frequent.
